title: Car Pooling
summary: Given a car with a specific capacity and a list of trips, where each trip specifies the number of passengers, the pickup location, and the drop-off location, determine if it is possible to transport all passengers eastward without exceeding the car's capacity at any point during the trips.
statement: Given a car with a specific capacity and a list of trips, where each trip specifies the number of passengers, the pickup location, and the drop-off location, determine if it is possible to transport all passengers eastward without exceeding the car's capacity at any point during the trips.
constraints: Passengers board at start and leave before boarding at the same end position.
Return whether capacity is never exceeded.
hints: Represent each trip as a pickup delta and drop-off delta.
Aggregate changes by position, with negative departures applied at the same coordinate.
Scan positions in order and reject when the running occupancy exceeds capacity.
The running sum equals passengers aboard on every interval between events.
editorial: The running sum equals passengers aboard on every interval between events.

tests.explanation: At positions three and four, five passengers exceed capacity four.
The first group exits at five before the next boards, so capacity three works.
